title: Codex telemetry
description: User and session activity, model usage and waiting time from Codex telemetry. Generated; see docs/integrations/codex-dashboard.md.

list.name: user
list.label: User email
list.description: Literal email search; blank includes everyone, including unattributed traffic.

list.name: session
list.label: Session
list.description: Literal conversation ID search; blank includes all sessions. Click a session row to select it.

links.title: Export PNG
links.tooltip: Full dashboard image; allow up to 3 minutes. Uses the selected time range and filters.

options.content: Search by email or click a session. Clear searches for everyone. Session times are observed bounds; identity coverage is fleet-wide. Estimates use a dated standard API rate card and are separate from actual billing, which is not connected. Code acceptance and retention are not yet measured.

panels.title: Active sessions
panels.description: Distinct conversations with meaningful events in the selected period; not session launches.

targets.expr: count(sum by (session)(count_over_time({job=~"codex-app-server|codex_cli_rs"} | json event="attributes[\"event.name\"]", user="attributes[\"user.email\"]", session="attributes[\"conversation.id\"]", model="attributes[\"model\"]", kind="attributes[\"event.kind\"]", input_tokens="attributes[\"input_token_count\"]", output_tokens="attributes[\"output_token_count\"]", cached_tokens="attributes[\"cached_token_count\"]", ttft_ms="attributes[\"ttft_ms\"]", duration_ms="attributes[\"duration_ms\"]" | __error__="" | user=~`.*${user:regex}.*` | session=~`.*${session:regex}.*` | event=~"codex.user_prompt|codex.tool_result|codex.sse_event" | (event!="codex.sse_event" or kind="response.completed") | session!=""[$__range])))

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: One row per conversation. Observed start and last activity are bounded by the selected period, not lifecycle timestamps. Blank cells mean no matching signal. Click a session to filter this dashboard. Turn time sums durations of turns ending in the selected period, including waits; it is not human active time or a union of overlapping turns. Estimates cover priced observations only; blank cells are unavailable. Prompt and response counts are observed events, not billing records.

panels.title: Estimated token cost · priced observations
panels.description: Standard US API-equivalent estimate at 2026-09-12 rates, not actual spend. Currently prices exact gpt-6-astra only with complete counters and zero cache writes. Long-context pricing is applied per response. Excludes service-tier adjustments, residency and tool fees. Sums observed responses, like the token totals; exporter replays can inflate both. This is not a billing ledger.

panels.title: Estimate coverage · responses
panels.description: Priced observations divided by all completed responses with a session. Old daemon versions, unknown models, missing counters and nonzero cache writes are unpriced. Cost is a partial sum when coverage is below 100%.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum(count_over_time({job=~"codex-app-server|codex_cli_rs"} |= "codex.sse_event" | json event="attributes[\"event.name\"]", user="attributes[\"user.email\"]", session="attributes[\"conversation.id\"]", model="attributes[\"model\"]", kind="attributes[\"event.kind\"]", input_tokens="attributes[\"input_token_count\"]", output_tokens="attributes[\"output_token_count\"]", cached_tokens="attributes[\"cached_token_count\"]", ttft_ms="attributes[\"ttft_ms\"]", duration_ms="attributes[\"duration_ms\"]" | __error__="" | event="codex.sse_event" | user=~`.*${user:regex}.*` | session=~`.*${session:regex}.*` | kind="response.completed" | json estimate_micro_usd="attributes[\"governance.estimate.micro_usd\"]", estimate_status="attributes[\"governance.estimate.status\"]", rate_card="attributes[\"governance.estimate.rate_card\"]" | __error__="" | session!="" | estimate_status="priced" | rate_card="openai-standard-us-2026-09-12"[$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum(count_over_time({job=~"codex-app-server|codex_cli_rs"} |= "codex.sse_event" | json event="attributes[\"event.name\"]", user="attributes[\"user.email\"]", session="attributes[\"conversation.id\"]", model="attributes[\"model\"]", kind="attributes[\"event.kind\"]", input_tokens="attributes[\"input_token_count\"]", output_tokens="attributes[\"output_token_count\"]", cached_tokens="attributes[\"cached_token_count\"]", ttft_ms="attributes[\"ttft_ms\"]", duration_ms="attributes[\"duration_ms\"]" | __error__="" | event="codex.sse_event" | user=~`.*${user:regex}.*` | session=~`.*${session:regex}.*` | kind="response.completed" | json estimate_micro_usd="attributes[\"governance.estimate.micro_usd\"]", estimate_status="attributes[\"governance.estimate.status\"]", rate_card="attributes[\"governance.estimate.rate_card\"]" | __error__="" | session!=""[$__range]))

panels.title: Turn metadata coverage · sessions
panels.description: Sessions with exported terminal turn metadata divided by sessions with meaningful native events. Requires the metadata exporter; sessions with only unfinished turns have no terminal metadata. Having metadata for a session does not mean every turn was measured.

targets.expr: 100 * (count(sum by (session)(count_over_time({job="governance-codex-session"} |= "governance.codex.turn" | json collector_user="resources[\"user.email\"]", session="attributes[\"conversation.id\"]", turn="attributes[\"turn.id\"]", repository="attributes.repository", duration_ms="attributes.duration_ms", ended="attributes.completed_at" | __error__="" | session!="" | turn!="" | session=~`.*${session:regex}.*` | ended >= ${__from:date:seconds} | ended <= ${__to:date:seconds}[$__range])) and sum by (session)(count_over_time({job=~"codex-app-server|codex_cli_rs"} | json event="attributes[\"event.name\"]", user="attributes[\"user.email\"]", session="attributes[\"conversation.id\"]", model="attributes[\"model\"]", kind="attributes[\"event.kind\"]", input_tokens="attributes[\"input_token_count\"]", output_tokens="attributes[\"output_token_count\"]", cached_tokens="attributes[\"cached_token_count\"]", ttft_ms="attributes[\"ttft_ms\"]", duration_ms="attributes[\"duration_ms\"]" | __error__="" | user=~`.*${user:regex}.*` | session=~`.*${session:regex}.*` | event=~"codex.user_prompt|codex.tool_result|codex.sse_event" | (event!="codex.sse_event" or kind="response.completed")[$__range]))) or vector(0)) / count(sum by (session)(count_over_time({job=~"codex-app-server|codex_cli_rs"} | json event="attributes[\"event.name\"]", user="attributes[\"user.email\"]", session="attributes[\"conversation.id\"]", model="attributes[\"model\"]", kind="attributes[\"event.kind\"]", input_tokens="attributes[\"input_token_count\"]", output_tokens="attributes[\"output_token_count\"]", cached_tokens="attributes[\"cached_token_count\"]", ttft_ms="attributes[\"ttft_ms\"]", duration_ms="attributes[\"duration_ms\"]" | __error__="" | user=~`.*${user:regex}.*` | session=~`.*${session:regex}.*` | event=~"codex.user_prompt|codex.tool_result|codex.sse_event" | (event!="codex.sse_event" or kind="response.completed") | session!=""[$__range])))

panels.title: Repositories · measured turn time
panels.description: Launch repository only when turn cwd matches launch cwd. Empty repository means unknown. Sums measured terminal turn durations, including waits. Multiple repositories remain separate; request token costs are not allocated using an assumed repository. User filters select native Codex sessions, correlated by session ID; governance login may differ.

targets.expr: sum by (repository)((sum by (session, repository)(max_over_time({job="governance-codex-session"} |= "governance.codex.turn" | json collector_user="resources[\"user.email\"]", session="attributes[\"conversation.id\"]", turn="attributes[\"turn.id\"]", repository="attributes.repository", duration_ms="attributes.duration_ms", ended="attributes.completed_at" | __error__="" | session!="" | turn!="" | session=~`.*${session:regex}.*` | ended >= ${__from:date:seconds} | ended <= ${__to:date:seconds} | unwrap duration_ms | __error__=""[$__range]) by (collector_user, session, turn, repository))) and on (session) (sum by (session)(count_over_time({job=~"codex-app-server|codex_cli_rs"} | json event="attributes[\"event.name\"]", user="attributes[\"user.email\"]", session="attributes[\"conversation.id\"]", model="attributes[\"model\"]", kind="attributes[\"event.kind\"]", input_tokens="attributes[\"input_token_count\"]", output_tokens="attributes[\"output_token_count\"]", cached_tokens="attributes[\"cached_token_count\"]", ttft_ms="attributes[\"ttft_ms\"]", duration_ms="attributes[\"duration_ms\"]" | __error__="" | user=~`.*${user:regex}.*` | session=~`.*${session:regex}.*` | event=~"codex.user_prompt|codex.tool_result|codex.sse_event" | (event!="codex.sse_event" or kind="response.completed")[$__range]))))
